borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Surface 2 (`#3A3A3A`): Higher elevation — popovers, pressed rows, video-tile placeholder.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Light Divider (`#E5E5E5`): Hairline dividers in light appearance.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: The accent is Zoom Blue `#2D8CFF` — a confident, friendly blue used for the one action that matters on each screen: the big "Join" button, the "Start" pill, the active control state, links. It is the single brand color, used sparingly so that it always reads as *the* primary action. The one chromatic exception is the in-call red `#E02828`, reserved exclusively for "Leave"/"End" and the muted-microphone indicator — the two moments where the app needs to communicate urgency or a live-risk state. There is no third accent; status and structure are carried by gray, white, and the blue.

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: Surface 1 (`#2D2D2D`): Cards, list rows, the in-call control bar, sheets.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心
panels.body: 适合在 390×844 画布中预览的移动产品体验。

panels.title: 颜色与字体可复用
panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use the committed dark theater ({#1A1A1A}) inside a call so video is the brightest element。
建议：Reserve Zoom Blue ({#2D8CFF}) for the primary action (Join/Start), active controls, and links。
建议：Reserve in-call red ({#E02828}) for Leave/End and the muted-mic state only。
建议：Make the Join button oversized (48pt tall, 17pt bold) — it is the app's center of gravity。
建议：Use rounded 8pt video tiles with small corner name labels so faces dominate。
dont: 避免：keep a light background inside a call — it competes with participant video。
避免：introduce a third accent color — blue for action, red for leave/mute, gray for everything else。
避免：make name labels large — 13pt max; the gallery is about faces, not text。
避免：let the active-speaker border flicker — debounce it。
避免：keep the control bar permanently visible over video — auto-hide is the behavior。
